AddAgentPath.name: AddAgentPath
AddAgentPath.description: This API is used to add the file paths you want to back up from a client. Path validity will not be checked.

AddMember.name: AddMember
AddMember.description: This API is used to add a member with whom the backup can be shared. Only cloud server backups can be shared among tenants in the same region.

AddVaultResource.name: AddVaultResource
AddVaultResource.description: This API is used to associate resources with a vault.

AssociateVaultPolicy.name: AssociateVaultPolicy
AssociateVaultPolicy.summary: Binding a Policy to a Vault
AssociateVaultPolicy.description: This API is used to bind a policy to a vault.

BatchCreateAndDeleteVaultTags.name: BatchCreateAndDeleteVaultTags
BatchCreateAndDeleteVaultTags.summary: Batch Adding or Deleting Tags of a Vault
BatchCreateAndDeleteVaultTags.description: This API is used to add or delete tags for a specified resource in batches. TMS uses this API to manage service resource tags. A resource can have a maximum of 10 tags. This API is idempotent. If there are duplicate keys in the request body when you add tags, an error is reported. If a to-be-created tag has the same k…

BatchUpdateVault.name: BatchUpdateVault
BatchUpdateVault.description: This API is used to batch modify all vaults in a project.

ChangeOrder.name: ChangeOrder
ChangeOrder.description: This API is used to update the order information of a yearly/monthly product and return the information about the order to be paid. > This API is in the OBT phase and cannot be used in some regions.

ChangeVaultChargeMode.name: ChangeVaultChargeMode
ChangeVaultChargeMode.description: This API is used to change the billing mode of a resource. Currently, only pay-per-use resources can be changed to yearly/monthly resources. > This API is in the open beta test (OBT) phase and may be unavailable in some regions.

CheckAgent.name: CheckAgent
CheckAgent.description: This API is used to check the Agent status required by application-consistent.

CopyBackup.name: CopyBackup
CopyBackup.description: This API is used to replicate a backup across regions.

CopyCheckpoint.name: CopyCheckpoint
CopyCheckpoint.description: This API is used to replicate a restore point.

CreateCheckpoint.name: CreateCheckpoint
CreateCheckpoint.description: This API is used to back up a vault and generate a restore point.

CreateOrganizationPolicy.name: CreateOrganizationPolicy
CreateOrganizationPolicy.description: This API is used to create an organization policy.

CreatePolicy.name: CreatePolicy
CreatePolicy.description: This API is used to create a policy. Policies are classified into backup policies and replication policies.

CreatePostPaidVault.name: CreatePostPaidVault
CreatePostPaidVault.description: This API is used to create a yearly/monthly vault in a combined purchase. It is an internal API.

CreateVault.name: CreateVault
CreateVault.description: This API is used to create a vault.

CreateVaultTags.name: CreateVaultTags
CreateVaultTags.summary: Adding a Tag to an Associated Resource
CreateVaultTags.description: This API is used to add a tag to an associated resource. A resource can have a maximum of 10 tags. The API is idempotent. If a to-be-created tag has the same key as an existing tag, the tag will be created and overwrite the existing one.

DeleteBackup.name: DeleteBackup
DeleteBackup.description: This API is used to delete a single backup.

DeleteMember.name: DeleteMember
DeleteMember.description: This API is used to delete a specified backup share member.

DeleteOrganizationPolicy.name: DeleteOrganizationPolicy
DeleteOrganizationPolicy.description: This API is used to delete an organization policy.

DeletePolicy.name: DeletePolicy
DeletePolicy.description: This API is used to delete a policy.

DeleteVault.name: DeleteVault
DeleteVault.description: This API is used to delete vaults. Once a vault is deleted, all backups in the vault are cleared.

DeleteVaultTag.name: DeleteVaultTag
DeleteVaultTag.summary: Deleting a Tag from an Associated Resource
DeleteVaultTag.description: This API is used to delete a tag from an associated resource. The API is idempotent. When you delete a nonexistent tag, error code 404 will be returned. Tag keys cannot be empty or be empty character strings.

DisassociateVaultPolicy.name: DisassociateVaultPolicy
DisassociateVaultPolicy.summary: Unbinding a Vault from a Policy
DisassociateVaultPolicy.description: This API is used to unbind a vault from a policy.

ImportBackup.name: ImportBackup
ImportBackup.description: This API is used to synchronize on-premises VMware backups.

ImportCheckpoint.name: ImportCheckpoint
ImportCheckpoint.description: This API is used to synchronize backups for a vault.

ListAgent.name: ListAgent
ListAgent.description: This API is used to query the client list.

ListBackups.name: ListBackups
ListBackups.description: This API is used to query all backups.

ListDomainProjects.name: ListDomainProjects
ListDomainProjects.summary: Querying the Project List of a Tenant
ListDomainProjects.description: This API is used to query the project list based on a specified tenant name.

ListExternalVault.name: ListExternalVault
ListExternalVault.summary: Querying the Vault List in Other Regions
ListExternalVault.description: This API is used to query the vault list in other regions.

ListFeatures.name: ListFeatures
ListFeatures.description: Querying Features Supported by CBR > This API is in the open beta test (OBT) phase and may be unavailable in some regions.

ListOpLogs.name: ListOpLogs
ListOpLogs.description: This API is used to query the task list.

ListOrganizationPolicies.name: ListOrganizationPolicies
ListOrganizationPolicies.description: This API is used to query the organizational policy list.

ListOrganizationPolicyDetail.name: ListOrganizationPolicyDetail
ListOrganizationPolicyDetail.description: This API is used to query the organization policy delivery info of each account.

ListPolicies.name: ListPolicies
ListPolicies.description: This API is used to query the policy list.

ListProjects.name: ListProjects
ListProjects.summary: This API is used to query the project information of a tenant.
ListProjects.description: This API is used to query the enterprise project information of a tenant.

ListProtectable.name: ListProtectable
ListProtectable.description: This API is used to query the list of resources that can be protected.

ListVault.name: ListVault
ListVault.description: This API is used to query the vault list.

MigrateDomain.name: MigrateDomain
MigrateDomain.description: This API is used to migrate CSBS or VBS resources to CBR.

MigrateVaultResource.name: MigrateVaultResource
MigrateVaultResource.description: This API is used to associate resources with another vault and migrate the resource backups to that destination vault.

RegisterAgent.name: RegisterAgent
RegisterAgent.description: This API is used to register a client during agent installation. This API is called automatically by the Agent. Manual registration is not required.

RemoveAgentPath.name: RemoveAgentPath
RemoveAgentPath.description: This API is used to remove the file paths added for backup.

RemoveVaultResource.name: RemoveVaultResource
RemoveVaultResource.description: This API is used to dissociate resources from a vault.

RestoreBackup.name: RestoreBackup
RestoreBackup.description: This API is used to restore backup data.

SetVaultResource.name: SetVaultResource
SetVaultResource.summary: Setting Auto Backup for a Vault
SetVaultResource.description: This API is used to enable or disable auto backup for a vault.

ShowAgent.name: ShowAgent
ShowAgent.description: This API is used to query a specified client.

ShowBackup.name: ShowBackup
ShowBackup.description: This API is used to query the backup of a specific ID.

ShowCheckpoint.name: ShowCheckpoint
ShowCheckpoint.description: This API is used to query a specified restore point based on its ID.

ShowDomain.name: ShowDomain
ShowDomain.description: This is an internal API called by the console. It is used to obtain the domain name of the source project ID only when querying a shared backup.

ShowFeature.name: ShowFeature
ShowFeature.description: This API is used to query a specified feature supported by CBR. > This API is in the open beta test (OBT) phase and may be unavailable in some regions.

ShowMemberDetail.name: ShowMemberDetail
ShowMemberDetail.description: This API is used to obtain the details of a backup share member.

ShowMembersDetail.name: ShowMembersDetail
ShowMembersDetail.description: This API is used to obtain the list of backup share members.

ShowMetadata.name: ShowMetadata
ShowMetadata.description: This API is used to query the metadata of the resources that are backed up.

ShowMigrateStatus.name: ShowMigrateStatus
ShowMigrateStatus.description: This API is used to query the migration result.

ShowOpLog.name: ShowOpLog
ShowOpLog.description: This API is used to query a task by task ID.

ShowOrganizationPolicy.name: ShowOrganizationPolicy
ShowOrganizationPolicy.description: This API is used to query a specified organizational policy.

ShowPolicy.name: ShowPolicy
ShowPolicy.description: This API is used to query a single policy.

ShowProtectable.name: ShowProtectable
ShowProtectable.description: This API is used to query a specified resource that can be protected by its ID.

ShowReplicationCapabilities.name: ShowReplicationCapabilities
ShowReplicationCapabilities.description: This API is used to query the replication capability of the current region.

ShowStorageUsage.name: ShowStorageUsage
ShowStorageUsage.description: This API is used to query capacity statistics.

ShowSummary.name: ShowSummary
ShowSummary.summary: Querying Vault Usage of a Tenant
ShowSummary.description: This API is used to query the total capacity and used capacity of all vaults of a tenant.

ShowVault.name: ShowVault
ShowVault.description: This API is used to query a specified vault based on its ID.

ShowVaultProjectTag.name: ShowVaultProjectTag
ShowVaultProjectTag.summary: Querying Tags of a Vault Project
ShowVaultProjectTag.description: This API is used to query a tenant's tag set in a specific region and of a specific instance type. TMS uses this API to list tags created by a tenant to facilitate tag creation and resource filtering on the console.

ShowVaultResourceInstances.name: ShowVaultResourceInstances
ShowVaultResourceInstances.description: This API is used to filter resources by tag. Tag Management Service (TMS) uses this API to filter and list resources of each service by tag. These services must have the query capabilities.

ShowVaultTag.name: ShowVaultTag
ShowVaultTag.summary: Querying Tags of an Associated Resource
ShowVaultTag.description: This API is used to query tags of a specified resource. TMS uses this API to query all tags of a specified resource.

UnregisterAgent.name: UnregisterAgent
UnregisterAgent.description: This API is used to remove a client. All backups of a client will be deleted after the client is removed.

UpdateAgent.name: UpdateAgent
UpdateAgent.description: This API is used to change the status of a client.

UpdateBackup.name: UpdateBackup
UpdateBackup.description: This API is used to modify a backup name based on a given backup ID.

UpdateMemberStatus.name: UpdateMemberStatus
UpdateMemberStatus.description: This API is used to update the status of a backup share member.

UpdateOrder.name: UpdateOrder
UpdateOrder.description: Used for updating yearly/monthly subscription order information

UpdateOrganizationPolicy.name: UpdateOrganizationPolicy
UpdateOrganizationPolicy.description: This API is used to update an organization policy.

UpdatePolicy.name: UpdatePolicy
UpdatePolicy.description: This API is used to modify a policy.

UpdateVault.name: UpdateVault
UpdateVault.description: This API is used to modify a vault based on its ID.
